about: The Hollow Cairn's ground and the sheepfold below it (Book 4 section 02; Book 9 sections 03 and 05): blocks 24 to 35 by 18 to 23, east of the machair, expanded by src/tools/levels/zones.ts. The grassed mound stands at block (31, 20) with its sealed door on the east; the drystone sheepfold at block (28, 22), its gate on the west towards the steading; Bran can be spoken to over its east wall, unseen from the gate. Bran keeps Thorkel's body in the fold (Book 4 Chapter 1 beat 3; decisions S10-5 and S10-6). Edit this plan, not the generated map, then run npm run zones.
